recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up core edit is recommended unless the Vocabulary work group later revisits metadata-only ValueSet or summary-search validation semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-17475 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3 and requested removal of ValueSet invariant VSD-5 because it conflicted with ValueSet?_summary=true responses that return metadata without .compose or .expansion; the resolution also required guidance for both, either, or neither of .compose and .expansion.
initial_application: Jira records the resolution as pre-applied in svn 14497. Git-svn commit 37b0ae652bb936957e6a8ccbecdcc8a17e97d6e4 removed invariant 5 from source/valueset/valueset-spreadsheet.xml, removed the VSD-5 condition from compose and expansion, and added the combinations-of-.compose-and-.expansion guidance to source/valueset/valueset-notes.xml.
additional_context: ValueSet is an active build-scope resource in source/fhir.ini. Current source has ValueSet.compose and ValueSet.expansion as 0..1, has no VSD-5 source match, and includes both the detailed combinations section and later introductory wording that ValueSet may carry neither element when only metadata is represented. Zulip discussion supports the same interpretation, and no Confluence evidence was found that changes it. FHIR-18677 is a same-family later clarification already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current build-scope source already satisfies the accepted FHIR-17475 request.
